# Generated by tools/rework_savinkov_opening.py --write
on_actions = {
    on_startup = { effect = { RUS = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes country_event = rus_opening.3 } } }
    on_ruling_party_change_immediate = {
        effect = { if = { limit = { original_tag = RUS } RUS_opening_finish_phase = yes } }
    }
    on_daily_RUS = {
        effect = {
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_retired_savinkov_layout_refreshed } }
                set_country_flag = RUS_retired_savinkov_layout_refreshed
                mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
            }
            RUS_opening_finish_phase = yes
            RUS_opening_check_popular_anger = yes
            RUS_opening_check_military_anger = yes
            if = { limit = { has_idea = RUS_opening_disordered_industry } add_manpower = -200 }
        }
    }
}
